title: Wave-5 v5.0 ledger schema (figure-parity + workspace-reorg + three-layer comparison)
description: Schema for Wave-5.5 plan v5.0.4 ledger entries. plan_revision enum restricted to {v5.0, v5.1}; v4.x records cannot pass enum (mutual rejection impossible-by-construction). Required base block mirrors v4.2 minus biology-aware-only fields. New v5.0.4 fields: figure_outputs (triple-SHA per figure), parameter_divergence_table_path, quantitative_similarity_metrics_path, reproduction_rate, rna_only_figures_path, rna_only_reviewer_context_isolation, trevino_paper_pdf_sha, trevino_figure_mapping_path, comparison_pdf_symlink_history.

run_id.description: Run-id of the parent canonical v4.2 run that v5.0 figures are derived from.

plan_revision.description: v5.0 enum strictly excludes v4.x to enforce mutual rejection impossible-by-construction with wave5_v4_2.schema.json.

parent_canonical_run_id.description: Run-id of the parent v4.2 canonical run that v5.0 builds upon. Required per AC-V5-LEDGER-2. Expected value for current Wave-5.5: 20260516T0931Z-d192836f1bb0.

parent_v42_ledger_sha.description: SHA-256 of the parent v4.2 ledger file (binding provenance chain). Required per AC-V5-LEDGER-2.

figure_outputs.description: Per-figure triple-format SHA-256 digests per AC-V5-FIG-1.

figure_spec_sha.description: SHA-256 of FIGURE_SPEC.md at render time. Must match Stage 0 sign-off SHA per spec-hash assertion.

safeguard_reports_dir.description: Directory containing per-figure <fig>_safeguard_report.json files (6 booleans each per AC-V5-FIG-3).

parameter_divergence_table_path.description: Path to per-figure parameter divergence JSON dir per AC-V5-COMP-PARAM-1.

quantitative_similarity_metrics_path.description: Path to per-figure quantitative metrics JSON dir per AC-V5-COMP-QUANT-1.

reproduction_rate.description: Per-figure + overall reproduction-rate scores per AC-V5-REPRO-RATE-1.

rna_only_reviewer_context_isolation.description: Per HARKing safeguard #6: MUST be true for any v5.0 ledger entry that includes Stream A2 RNA-only figures.

comparison_pdf_symlink_history.description: Per Arch-2 Fix #3: history of comparison.pdf symlink targets (each entry is {old_target, new_target, swap_iso}).

comparison_pdf_current_sha.description: Current comparison_<sha>.pdf SHA-256 (matches symlink_history[-1].new_target without the comparison_ prefix).

branch_base_sha.description: Base SHA of wave5-v5.0-figures branch (Arch-2 Fix #6 timing constraint enforced).

cell_figure_use_acknowledgment_path.description: Path to signed acknowledgment file per AC-V5-LICENSE-1 (90-day expiry).

embed_cell_figures_opted_in.description: True iff comparison.pdf was rendered with --embed-cell-figures opt-in flag.
